cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

mechanism: A treats the feared relationship ending as an expert diagnosis and corrects each reassuring detail into another stage of it.
confusable: Generic pessimism differs from matching every new emotional contribution to the same specific feared ending.
comparison: An illness message and soup become breakup preparation; cancelled lunch and a replacement booking become public separation.
seedUse: Keep the former-breakup precedent explicit and B's benign motives intact rather than validating A's conclusion as fact.
